_synthetic: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - analyst observation records for the UIOWA-092 rehearsal. Every statement is fictional and none is a University finding.

observations.claim: All three repositories in the ESS export require a pull request with at least one approving review and a passing build-and-test status check before merge to the default branch.
observations.scope_limit: Three fictional repositories; export reflects configuration on 2026-09-18 only.

count_assertion.unit: repositories with required review and status check

observations.follow_up: Confirm the repository inventory is complete before any group-wide statement.

observations.claim: Every sampled merged pull request recorded at least one approving review and a passing status check; none was merged without review.
observations.scope_limit: Eight sampled pull requests from 2026Q3; not a census.

count_assertion.unit: sampled pull requests with an approving review

observations.follow_up: Widen the sample or request the full merge history for the period.

observations.claim: August production deployments and rollbacks are recorded against deployment identifiers in a single log, giving a usable deployment history.
observations.scope_limit: One month of one fictional group's deployments.
observations.follow_up: Confirm whether the log is the authoritative record or a secondary copy.

observations.claim: Six of fourteen August deployments landed outside the Tuesday/Thursday window defined by the release standard, and three of those six carry no documented exception.
observations.scope_limit: August only; the standard's exception process may be recorded elsewhere.

count_assertion.unit: out-of-window deployments without a documented exception

observations.follow_up: Ask whether exceptions are recorded in a separate system, or whether these were unexcepted.

observations.claim: A participant states that application access is reviewed quarterly.
observations.scope_limit: Interview statement only. No completed review was produced, and no artifact was offered.
observations.follow_up: Request one completed quarterly review with its date and the reviewing role.

observations.claim: Five of nine sampled RIS production releases record no test evidence reference.
observations.scope_limit: Nine sampled releases across three fictional applications; not a census.

count_assertion.unit: sampled releases without a test evidence reference

observations.follow_up: Ask whether test evidence is held outside the release record, and for which releases.

observations.claim: One sampled release recorded one approval where the release record itself states two are required.
observations.scope_limit: Single release REL-SYN-RIS-3005; the approval requirement is read from the same record.

count_assertion.unit: sampled releases below the recorded approval requirement

observations.follow_up: Ask whether this was an exception, a data-entry error, or a normal practice.

observations.claim: The August report evidences backup job completion for two applications but records no restoration exercise for any date, so recoverability is not demonstrated.
observations.scope_limit: Backup completion is evidenced; restoration is unevidenced rather than shown to fail.

count_assertion.unit: backup job records carrying a restoration exercise

observations.follow_up: Request the date and outcome of the most recent restoration test, if one exists.

observations.claim: A current vulnerability scan report exists, dated within the month of the rehearsal, with per-finding remediation targets.
observations.scope_limit: One report covering three fictional applications.
observations.follow_up: Confirm scan coverage against the application inventory.

observations.claim: Three of five scan findings are past their recorded remediation target as of 2026-09-19 and none carries a risk acceptance reference.
observations.scope_limit: Five findings in one report; remediation may be tracked in another system.

count_assertion.unit: findings past remediation target without risk acceptance

observations.follow_up: Ask where overdue findings are escalated and whether any acceptance exists off-report.

observations.claim: A participant describes informal individual use of an assistant to generate test data, not adopted by the team and not documented anywhere.
observations.scope_limit: Interview statement only. Informal experimentation, distinct from active adopted use.
observations.follow_up: Ask what inputs were used and whether any team-level guidance exists.

observations.claim: One of four sampled IAM configuration changes records a reviewer and a review evidence reference; the other three record neither.
observations.scope_limit: Four sampled August changes across three fictional services.
observations.follow_up: Ask whether review is recorded outside this export for the other three changes.

observations.claim: A participant states that every configuration change is reviewed by a second engineer before release.
observations.scope_limit: Interview statement only; it is not reconciled with the change export.
observations.follow_up: Reconcile the stated practice with the three changes that record no reviewer.

observations.claim: The 2026Q2 privileged access recertification closed with all 102 in-scope accounts dispositioned: 71 retained, 19 revoked, 8 scope-reduced and 4 open exceptions, each exception carrying a named owner and an expiry as the standard requires.
observations.scope_limit: One campaign, one quarter. Exception expiry dates were not independently checked against the accounts.
observations.follow_up: Request the next campaign's export to confirm the four exceptions closed at expiry.

observations.claim: A deployment log for IAM services was requested and identified in the source register, but the export was not provided during the rehearsal window.
observations.scope_limit: No deployment evidence was obtained for this group. Nothing about IAM deployment practice is established either way.
observations.follow_up: Re-request the August deployment export, or agree an alternative record.

observations.claim: An approved project charter records intent to evaluate an access-request triage assistant and states that no implementation, data provision or evaluation has occurred.
observations.scope_limit: Charter evidences intent only. Planned use, distinct from active or informal use.
observations.follow_up: Ask what would trigger a start and who would own an evaluation.
